compute_bond_orientational_order: calculate the Bond-Orientational Order for each node in a graph using spherical harmonics and neighbor direction vectors
map_sender_receiver_features: map node features to edge features by indexing sender features via neighbor list and broadcasting receiver features
compute_legendre_polynomials: compute Legendre polynomials P_0 through P_lmax for tensor elements using the standard recursive formula
get_compact_frequency_vectors: calculate a compact representation of frequency vectors from normalized edge direction vectors using spherical harmonics
create_attention_mask: create an attention mask and angle embedding from edge direction vectors and neighbor masks for graph attention layers
